'''Prime Adjunct''' was a title that was held by [[Ti-Ori Tamun]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who served as the second-in-command of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
